Welcome to NaC Workflows

Network as Code - Manage your network infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code

The intent of this tool is to demonstrate what is possible by using NaC-API. NaC API is a north bound API gateway to Source Code Managers. This allows you to interact with a source code repository (GIT) via API instead of human direct interaction.

This provides the ability to have automated workflows utilize Network as Code (NaC) to push configuration changes into your network with all the embeded benefits of validation that Network as Code provides. While providing different options on how to interface with NaC.

Operators that struggle with learning data structures (in this case YAML) could potentially use a tool similar to this to create workflows that take advantage of Network as Code to push configuration changes into their network with all the embeded benefits of validation that Network as Code provides.

NaC-API provides means to create a simple front-end towards the data structure used by Network as Code. NaC API interacts with underlying Source Code Managers (SCM) to retrieve and update the data model. NaC API supports Github, Gitlab, Bitbucket and even local file system representation of the model.
